summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around high-end MLCC exposure for AI server boards. The cleanest reference exposure remains Murata via OTC ADR, with TDK as a broader passive-components reference name. The underfollowed lane is weaker but includes Vishay as a US-listed passive-components manufacturer with MLCC product lines and Avnet as a second-order distributor/inventory-allocation beneficiary if AI-server passives shortages tighten. The main evidence gap is separating generic MLCC/passives exposure from the narrow high-capacitance, low-ESR, low-ESL AI-server-qualified MLCC mix.
